description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Currency' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library\Cart' namespace, managing currency data and formatting functions for the cart system in OpenCart.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class responsible for managing currency information, formatting, conversion, and retrieval within the cart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Currency class by retrieving currency data from the database.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number into a currency string with appropriate symbols and decimal places.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a monetary value from one currency to another based on stored currency exchange rates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the internal ID of a specific currency.

methods.name: getSymbolLeft
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol positioned to the left.

methods.name: getSymbolRight
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol positioned to the right.

methods.name: getDecimalPlace
methods.description: Returns the number of decimal places used by the currency.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the exchange rate value for the currency.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a specific currency exists in the loaded currencies.
